title: SEC1: temp dir collision in spawn_test_listener_binds_loopback_port
description: crates/kithd/tests/e2e.rs:71-72. The temp directory is named /tmp/kithd-test-listener-{pid}. If the test binary runs the same test function twice in parallel (e.g. via test repetition tools or if a future test calls spawn_test_listener directly with the same path), both invocations attempt to create/write the same path. spawn_test_pair() avoids this with a {pid}-{subsec_nanos} suffix (harness.rs:145) — the same pattern should be applied here. Low severity in normal cargo test runs (each test runs once), but inconsistent with the harness pattern.
